event.heading: Could the satellite see an event?
event.intro: Tell us when something happened (a storm, a river flood, a wildfire) and we will tell you whether NISAR passed over the area while it lasted. It does not say whether anything changed.
event.timeHelp: In Parral, UTC is local time plus 6 hours: 15:37 in Parral is 21:37 UTC.
event.error: The check could not be done. Review the date and try again.

state.observable: Observable: there was a pass while the event lasted

event.observableNote: This does not say that anything changed: for that, look at the verdict for the date pair that includes that pass.
